result.name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Log4Shell)
result.description: Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 are vulnerable to remote code execution.

nvt.insight: JNDI lookups in Log4j allow attackers to load arbitrary code.

result.name: SSL/TLS: Deprecated TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 Protocol Detection
result.description: The remote service supports TLSv1.0 and/or TLSv1.1 protocols which have known security weaknesses.

nvt.solution: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 in web server configuration.

result.name: OS End of Life Detection
result.description: Host operating system version has reached end-of-life status.

nvt.solution: Upgrade to a supported operating system distribution.

result.name: TCP Timestamps Supported
result.description: The remote host implements TCP timestamps.
